shared_context: The food stand at the charity market will operate for 6 hours and serve a diverse crowd. The menu should accommodate common dietary preferences and be easy to prepare onsite by a team of three volunteers.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a nutritionist passionate about promoting healthy and inclusive eating habits.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the menu offers fresh, vegetarian-friendly options that appeal to health-conscious visitors.

A.reason_for: Vegetarian sandwiches and salads align perfectly with my focus on health and inclusivity, offering fresh ingredients and gluten-free options.

B.reason_for: Quick to prepare and familiar, but limited for vegetarians and gluten-sensitive visitors.
B.reason_against: Contains gluten and meat, which excludes many dietary preferences I want to support.

C.reason_for: Refreshing and suitable for most diets including vegan and gluten-free, complementing the vegetarian option well.
C.reason_against: May not be filling enough as a main meal for some visitors.

D.reason_for: Variety and familiar flavors can attract a broad crowd.
D.reason_against: Long prep time and oven requirement make it less practical for our volunteer team.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is an event organizer who values variety and satisfying diverse tastes at community events.
personas.private_goal: Create a menu with broad appeal and familiar comfort foods that attract many attendees.

A.reason_for: Healthy vegetarian options are important and can attract health-conscious visitors.
A.reason_against: May not be hearty enough for those wanting meat-based meals.

B.reason_for: Quick prep and familiar to many, but limited for vegetarians and gluten-free attendees.
B.reason_against: Lacks variety and excludes some dietary needs.

C.reason_for: Healthy and refreshing, good as a complement to other options.
C.reason_against: Not filling enough to serve as a main meal.

D.reason_for: Offers variety and familiar flavors that satisfy different tastes, important for a diverse crowd.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a volunteer coordinator focused on efficiency and simplicity in event operations.
personas.private_goal: Keep menu items quick and easy to prepare onsite by a small volunteer team.

A.reason_for: Healthy and vegetarian, but prep time and ingredient count are higher than ideal.
A.reason_against: May be too complex for a small volunteer team during a busy event.

B.reason_for: Fast prep time and few ingredients make it ideal for quick service with limited volunteers.

C.reason_for: Easy to prepare and suitable for most diets, a good secondary option.
C.reason_against: Not filling enough for some visitors.

D.reason_for: Variety is good but long prep time and oven requirement make it impractical for our team.
D.reason_against: Too complex and time-consuming for a small volunteer group.
